head: 155b4a62f4b9acbc4488d6b79f47e1220589555e
classification_reasons: Spec: tight now. Both flagged concerns are closed by panel decisions 1 and 2, and every worked-example number is pinned to 1e-9. One open question stays open on purpose: the owner confirms the 0.1% default fee at the gate. Changing it means editing one constant.

Blast radius: a new package of four modules plus an edit to a shared file (pyproject.toml [tool.setuptools] packages). A typo there breaks the install and every CI job, and no test catches a missing entry. No risk-list item is touched, and no schema or contract changes.
Test coverage: the existing tests cover none of this. All the behaviour is new, and its only proof will be the new tests/test_backtest.py.
attempted: Intent: the design delivers the intent's engine. It is long/flat on one frame, fills at the next existing row's open (gap-agnostic), charges the fee on each fill, outputs equity, trades and summary, and refuses the intent's list of bad inputs. Open questions 2 and 3 take the recommended answers. Question 1's number is carried forward with the default already in place. This is not a quick intent. Nothing found.

Spec and plan after the panel: decision 1 shows in spec Flagged concerns, plan Files (pyproject line), order step 6 (wheel listing), Risks, Options not taken and Proof. Decision 2 shows in the plan's summary.py docstring line, step 2, Options not taken and the Proof note asserting trade_count == 0 and win_rate == 0.0 together. The design-1 review's minor gap is closed: step 3 now stores entry_cash. R1-R19 map to steps 1-6 and the 19 named Proof tests. Every intent acceptance bullet has a named test.

Lookahead and edge cases: row i fills at opens[i] from positions[i-1]. positions[last] is never read for a fill. The end-of-frame close uses closes[-1] and overwrites only the last equity value, so final equity = 1 + total return. An empty frame is refused before any positions check. A 1-row frame gives equity [1.0] and no trades. Nothing found.

Claims against today's code (merge base). pyproject.toml line 9 is packages = ["app", "app.data"]: true. app/data/__init__.py has a sorted __all__: true. InvalidRequestError(ValueError) is at app/data/params.py:61: true. KlineGapError.frame exists (loader.py:41-46): true. schema.py SCHEMA has open_time Datetime('ms','UTC') and Float64 open/close, and _finite rejects non-finite values: true. CLAUDE.md lines 4-7 are the 'one feature' paragraph, line 33 ends the app/data item and lines 36-37 are the tests item: true. Change 0002's verifier did build and list a wheel: true (it used --no-build-isolation, which plan step 6's command omits; a nit for the build verifier, not a park). docs/decisions/index.md does not exist, and the spec cites no decision.
Proof: this is the design phase, so there are no toolchain logs and no verifier report yet. The Proof section names the tests and the wheel listing the build must produce.

Blast radius: the diff holds only changes/0004-*/ (spec, plan, status, evidence, panel records). No guardrail file is in it. The planned code adds new files under app/backtest/ and tests/, plus one pyproject list entry. app/data and the existing tests stay unchanged. The CLAUDE.md lines are named for the owner, as the intent asks. Risk list: none touched (an in-memory simulation that moves no funds and holds no credentials or config).

Policies: security-baseline rule 2 is applied with a strict input schema (NaN or bool fee, bool, float or null positions, non-positive or non-finite prices). No-I/O and no-new-dependency are stated. ux-and-brand rule 4 shapes the error messages. data-conventions is correctly not applicable.

Tests (design level): the decision-candle and gap tests use distinct prices on either side, so an off-by-one fill would fail them. The two-trade test pins every equity value. The zero-trade test pins trade_count together with win_rate. Minor and not a park: step 2 mentions summary unit tests, but the Proof list names none; the summary is exercised through the engine tests.
Skip markers: not checked at design (the ratchets check runs at build and test).
Drive: not relevant at design; the plan lists no drive files.
